title: Unit – 1 : Session – 5 : SLO – 2  |  Matrix Multiplication
sections: 1. columns — valid only if columns of the first matrix equal rows of the second.
2. rows of first — the result has dimensions (rows of first) × (columns of second).
3. corresponding — multiply each row element with the corresponding column element.
4. each element (repeated/dot-product) — a loop is required for each computation.
5. nested — use three nested loops (i, j, k).
7. dot — the innermost loop calculates the dot product.
9. result — store the computed value in the result matrix res[i][j].
11. 2D arrays (contiguous memory) — matrix elements are stored in two-dimensional arrays.
13. dimensions — declare the result with proper r1 × c2 dimensions.
